claim_ceiling: In each of three source-hashed, separately timed public 16-bit TIFF capture products whose filenames identify the band as MB365UV, the preregistered f17r and f116v marginal traces remain visibly dark at corresponding apparent manuscript coordinates. Gross mounting and edge shadow patterns differ. This establishes three-capture persistence and rules out only a single-capture transient, a processed-composite-only artifact, and the particular visibly moving mounting or edge shadows as complete explanations. It does not establish absorptance, ink, stain, fluorescence response, lamp direction, radiometric equivalence, exclusion of static relief or fixed shadow, chronology, hand, reading, gloss, language, plaintext, meaning, or translation.

f116v.registered_target: initial mixed-script span of the lowest principal marginal line; right continuation crop-truncated

f17r.registered_target: complete faint upper marginal mixed-script line
